CREATE TABLE `TB_GARBAGE_AREA_CONV` (
  `No` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `postalCode` varchar(10) DEFAULT NULL,
  `administrativeArea` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `locality` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `thoroughfare` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `garbageGroupId` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `officialFlag` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `usageCount` int(11) DEFAULT '1',
  `garbageInfoName` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `latitude` decimal(9,6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `longitude` decimal(9,6) DEFAULT NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

ALTER TABLE `TB_GARBAGE_AREA_CONV`
  MODIFY `No` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, AUTO_INCREMENT=3934;

CREATE TABLE `TB_GARBAGE_INFO` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `garbageType` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `schedule` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `yobi` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `day` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `month` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `date` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `weekOfMonth` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `freqWeek` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

ALTER TABLE `TB_GARBAGE_INFO`
  MODIFY `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, AUTO_INCREMENT=1172;

CREATE TABLE `TB_USER_INFO` (
  `user_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `garbage_group_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `postal_code` varchar(10) NOT NULL,
  `administrative_area` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `sub_administrative_area` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `locality` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `sub_locality` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `thoroughfare` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `sub_thoroughfare` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `build_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `latitude` decimal(9,6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `longitude` decimal(9,6) DEFAULT NULL,
  `fcm_token` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_updated` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

CREATE TABLE `ad_address` (
  `id` int(9) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `ken_id` int(2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `city_id` int(5) DEFAULT NULL,
  `town_id` int(9) DEFAULT NULL,
  `zip` varchar(8) DEFAULT NULL,
  `office_flg` tinyint(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  `delete_flg` tinyint(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  `ken_name` varchar(8) DEFAULT NULL,
  `ken_furi` varchar(8) DEFAULT NULL,
  `city_name` varchar(24) DEFAULT NULL,
  `city_furi` varchar(24) DEFAULT NULL,
  `town_name` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `town_furi` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `town_memo` varchar(16) DEFAULT NULL,
  `kyoto_street` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `block_name` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `block_furi` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `memo` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `office_name` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `office_furi` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `office_address` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `new_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;
